meaning:
ἀ-σάλευτος, -ον
(σαλεύω), [in LXX: Exo.13:16, Deu.6:8 11:18 (טוֹפָפָה)* ;]
unmoved, immovable: Act.27:41; metaphorically, Heb.12:28.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence…
Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
